title: Scaling Identity Coherence
equation: Scaling Identity Coherence = (Brand + Experience + Cultural + Strategic Consistency) ÷ 4
hook: The bigger you get, the easier it is to slowly turn into a brand you don't even recognize.
statement: Growth wears down your identity unless you actively protect it.
explainer: New hires, new offers, new channels. Each one shifts things a little. Nobody notices until customers say you feel different. Decide what's core now, while it's still easy.
sop: Write one paragraph on what your brand stands for today.
Pick the 3 things that should never change as you grow.
Score Brand, Experience, Cultural, and Strategic Consistency 1 to 10.
Put those non-negotiables in one onboarding doc for every new hire.
Rescore every 6 months and fix the lowest one first.
equation_example: Brand 8, Experience 7, Cultural 6, Strategic 9. (8 + 7 + 6 + 9) ÷ 4 = 7.5 out of 10. Higher means you still feel like you as you grow. Lower means growth is quietly sanding off what made you different.
question: Write the three things about your business you'd never change, even at 10x the size.
closing_statement: Decide what can't change before growth decides for you.
caption:
Principle Nº 100: Scaling Identity Coherence

The bigger you get, the easier it is to slowly turn into a brand you don't even recognize.

Growth wears down your identity unless you actively protect it.
